EC1: the child has temperature > 39.0◦C or a severe acute illness as defined by the examining nurse
EC2: the child has as a mid upper arm circumference < 110 mm and is older than 6 months (most feasible local indicator of AIDS and chronic immunosuppressive disease)
EC3: the child has experienced a severe allergic reaction after previous vaccination [OR], drug [OR] or food.
